newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura says can catch up with foreign rivals.
newsitem.headline: Nomura says can catch up with foreign rivals.

text.p: The new president of Nomura Securities Co Ltd said on Thursday the scandal-tainted brokerage would be able to catch up with its foreign rivals in one to two years and may even overtake them in some fields.

"If we try with all our strength, we will easily be able to catch up with our foreign rivals within one to two years and in some areas, I think, we can even overtake them," said Junichi Ujiie, who became Nomura's president on Thursday.
He made the remarks in an in-house speech to the brokerage's employees. A copy of the speech was released to the media.

Ujiie said that Nomura was capable of taking responsibility for a key role in capitalism's growth and that he would change Nomura into a company which always obeys the law and acts with confidence and pride.
"We need to do it now. This is our last chance. I will change Nomura with courage and conviction," Ujiie said.

Nomura announced last week that then-managing director Ujiie would take over as the company's president in a sweeping management shake-up, after prosecutors and Japan's securities watchdog launched an investigation of the brokerage for suspected illegal deals linked to corporate racketeers.
